purpose: Classify successive verified samvrti world versions inside one paramartha fiber as reversible local dynamics, cumulative drift, structural drift, or disconnected history without reclassifying paramartha automatically.
predecessor: KuuOS Samvrti World Effect Update v7.14

dynamics_classes.reversible_local_samvrti_dynamics: Continuous history, stable binding/context, bounded local change, high reversibility/recoverability and bounded impact.
dynamics_classes.cumulative_samvrti_drift: Continuous same-fiber history with repeated directional change or accumulated local change, while binding and structural context remain stable.
dynamics_classes.structural_world_drift_rebind_required: World binding signature, structural context, or an explicit revalidation request changed; world-dependent bindings must be rechecked.
dynamics_classes.single_world_transition_observed: One verified transition exists but there is not yet enough history for drift classification.
dynamics_classes.samvrti_dynamics_indeterminate: History is continuous but the evidence does not justify the other classifications.
dynamics_classes.samvrti_world_history_disconnected: Successive versions do not compose by prior/observed world-state digest.
dynamics_classes.paramartha_fiber_obstructed: Versions do not remain in one paramartha fiber.

next: feed verified samvrti dynamics into belief and planning revision so local reversible changes update context cheaply while structural drift selectively invalidates world-dependent assumptions
